faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes — new shops get a 14-day free trial, no card required. All Growth features stay active during the trial.
faq.q2: What happens when the trial ends?
faq.a2: After the trial, upgrade to ৳999/month to keep automatic replies and order capture running. If you do not, automatic replies pause, but you can still reply yourself from the inbox — no data is lost.
faq.q3: How many customer conversations do I get per month?
faq.a3: Enough for a typical growing shop (fair-use). If you need more, you can buy a conversation top-up anytime from the Subscription page.
faq.q4: What happens when the conversation limit runs out?
faq.a4: You get a free buffer; after that, AI auto-reply pauses. Buy a top-up pack from the Subscription page to resume instantly.
faq.q5: How do I apply for the Partner plan?
faq.a5: Apply via 'Learn about the Partner Plan' at the bottom of the Pricing page. We verify 300+ orders/month and activate it — charged per delivered order, with no monthly fee.
